title: Azure Function SQL Trigger: how to use it (and why it can be useful in your Business Central projects)
summary: Azure SQL Triggers for Azure Functions enable real-time event-driven integrations with Business Central by automatically triggering a function when data changes occur in a SQL database. The post demonstrates setup, implementation, and testing of SQL change tracking to synchronize external application data with Business Central.
key_points: Azure SQL Trigger Binding uses SQL change tracking to detect INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE operations on monitored tables
Enable change tracking on the database and table using T-SQL before configuring the Azure Function trigger
Create an Azure Function using the SqlTriggerBindingIsolated template with .NET 8 Isolated runtime
The solution enables serverless, event-driven integrations where external systems can push data to Business Central automatically when changes occur
features: Azure SQL Triggers for Azure Functions
